title: Home screen — three structures
question: Three ways for the home screen to lead to Day's end, rendered by Higgsfield from your Taste library references. Lock one, steer, or re-roll.

options.label: Stones in a tray
options.thesis: The areas are smooth stones resting together; the ones you touched today glow from inside.
materials: polished stone with a soft sheen
gentle relief: some rise, one presses in
options.viewport: Greeting and date on top; seven stones loosely grouped in the middle; one larger stone, pressed in, reads Day's end · 3 questions waiting; Better · Journal · Me at the bottom.
options.risk: Stones are loose by nature, so finding one area quickly depends on their order staying fixed.

options.label: The day as a ring
options.thesis: One thin ring is today, 04:00 to 04:00; the areas sit on it and light up as the day fills.
materials: warm light spilling along the ring
options.viewport: Greeting on top; a large ring with a dot for now (21:40) and seven nodes on it; Day's end pressed into the centre; a quiet line under the ring saying what is lit.
options.risk: A ring that means time invites reading positions as times, and the areas are not tied to hours.

options.label: Today's balance
options.thesis: A glass donut of seven segments, each with a thin line out to what happened in that area today.
options.viewport: Greeting on top; the donut in the middle with labels on both sides (Nutrition · 1,640 kcal, Planning · 3 of 5, Hobbies · nothing yet…); Day's end in the hole.
options.risk: The most information of the three, so it is the one most likely to feel like a dashboard instead of an evening.
